name: jtb
description: One entry point for the whole marketplace. Type /jtb with a ticket, a pull request, pasted notes, or nothing at all; it works out which agents fit, asks what you want done (test it, triage it, clean it up, write acceptance tests, ...), runs the matching plugin command, then offers the step that naturally follows and keeps going until you say done. Say what you want in the same line (/jtb 1234 clean it up) and it skips the first question. It never does an agent's work and never writes to the tracker itself: every write still passes through the gate of the agent that owns it. Installing it installs every other plugin in the marketplace.
